Subject: New vendor onboarding - required info and portal

Hi Kimberly,

We're ready to add Redwood Inference as an approved supplier in our AP system and need a short set of items to complete the vendor record so POs and payments flow without delay. Can you confirm the following and return the documents?

Required items:
- Legal entity name and DBA (exact wording for our vendor record)
- Tax form (W-9 if US entity) or VAT registration if EU entity
- Remit-to address for paper checks (if applicable)
- Bank wiring details (ACH for US, IBAN/SWIFT for international)
- Sample invoice PDF (we use this for our mapping team)
- Contact name + email for AP onboarding call

Also: do you accept PO matching (PO number required on invoice) and do you have a vendor ID if you've been in our SupplierConnect portal before? If not, we'll open a vendor request and share the registration link — our portal sometimes imposes payment holds until the portal form is complete.

Preferred payment terms: Net 30 by default; please flag if you require different terms.

Thanks — we need the info by end of week to avoid delaying the initial PO.

Best,
Olivia Grant
Senior Procurement Specialist
CedarPoint Logistics

Kimberly / Marcus — thanks for the quick responses and attachments. A few follow-ups from our AP intake team: 

1) Please complete the SupplierConnect registration here: https://supplierportal.cedarpoint.com/vendor-enroll/REQ-1112 — the portal will generate a temporary vendor ID that triggers our tax validation.
2) We will need a copy of the company registration (certificate of incorporation) in addition to the W-9 for our vendor risk team.
3) For invoicing to our UK subsidiary (CedarPoint UK Ltd), we require either a UK VAT number on the supplier record or the invoice to be handled under reverse charge. Can Marcus confirm whether Redwood can bill the UK entity using reverse charge treatment?
4) Early payment: we can do 1% / 10 days if you accept an early-pay enrollment in our financing program. Let us know if Redwood is open to that.

If you can register today and send the incorporation doc, we should be able to approve the vendor record by EOD tomorrow and issue the first PO. If you'd prefer, we can schedule a 30-minute onboarding call at 11:00 AM ET today.

Best,
Olivia
